rowText: A question that does not name a boss -> story-adjacent detail should still be fenced. Fourth try, on a new not-yet-tried phrasing.

setup.question: how do i beat the boss at the end of the first area
setup.why_this_phrasing: Not tried in any of the first three attempts ('what happens when i finally reach the surface' x2, 'how does the story end', 'who is waiting at the end of the game').

steps.action: Same send as HADES-UNNAMED-STREAM-01 (see that file for the workaround steps and log lines) -- one ask serves both rows since they read the same reply for two different things.
Read the finished reply in full
steps.observed: Plain text throughout: general advice about charms, poison resistance vs healing, and route choice at the Temple of Styx. No boss is named anywhere in the reply. An honesty line appears: 'No close match in my notes, this answer leans on the model's own knowledge.' The reply ends with a two-button follow-up menu ('A. Early in the game...' / 'B. Later in the game...'). No spoiler box, no masked fence, no tap-to-reveal control anywhere in the reply.

verdictSentence: The fourth try still came back unfenced -- no boss name, but also no spoiler box protecting the general fight advice it did give. Three of four tried phrasings have now failed to produce a spoiler box; only the two 'how does the story end' / 'who is waiting at the end' phrasings passed.
notes: This is the SAME finding the maintainer's new three-star bug is about (a name-withheld boss question getting a plain, unfenced reply). Recording it here again, with Hades specifically and a game genuinely running, is direct on-device evidence for that bug, not just the earlier nothing-running sightings. Still mixed overall, not closed.
